unit:
# /lib/systemd/system/wfb-fl-client-daemon.service
[Unit]
Description=WFB-ng FL client persistent daemon
After=network.target
Wants=network.target

[Service]
Type=simple
ExecStart=/usr/bin/wfb-fl-client-daemon --config /etc/wfb-ng-fl/node.json
KillMode=control-group
TimeoutStopSec=15s
Restart=always
RestartSec=3s
StandardOutput=journal
StandardError=journal

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target

# /run/systemd/system/wfb-fl-client-daemon.service.d/radio.conf
[Service]
ExecStart=
ExecStart=/usr/bin/wfb-fl-client-daemon --config /etc/wfb-ng-fl/node.json --uplink-mcs 4 --radio-txpower-dbm 14
